title: Community Event: Ambassador Hide and Seek (Las Escondidas)
names_seen: Community Event: Ambassador Hide and Seek (Las Escondidas)

facts.statement: A community hide-and-seek event was held on Server 3 on Friday 21 August 2009 from 1pm to 3pm Pacific time, with Community Team ambassadors hiding for players to find.
facts.quote: Viernes 21 de agosto de 2009 1pm – 3pm tiempo pacifico Servidor 3

facts.statement: Players who are first to find a hidden ambassador receive game coins as a prize; after an ambassador is found, they challenge the player to a duel and then resume hiding.
facts.quote: Si eres el primero en encontrar al embajador, te obsequiara unas monedas de juego como premio.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - ¿Qué novedades hay? (Community Event: "Las Escondidas")
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing a community hide-and-seek event on Server 3 on Friday 21 August 2009, 1pm-3pm Pacific time. Community Team ambassadors hide in the Bosque Espino area and players search for them, challenging an ambassador to a duel once found; the first finder gets game coins. The post gives the event schedule and reward but not a full route or the exact in-game names.
